title: BlueFlow
description: A small resource pack that changes the water, making it slightly clearer and brighter, making it more pleasing to the eye.
body:
#                                        +  BLUEFLOW  +

**This texture pack adds a small addition to the game that will help you survive and make the game more pleasing to the eye.!**

![It is recommended that you use it with Full Brightness mod!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04d4ef780dfafdb11a618976733925e28063dcad_0.webp)

**Makes the water texture 50% clearer!! Whether you like to be able to see the fish you're trying to catch or you just like to look at the ocean floor this is the texture pack for you**

**(ignore the warning when installing pack saying that it doesn't work on this version - it does)**
